Bonjour, bienvenue

More than coffee.
A feeling.

Café de Casa brings together a distinctive art-filled interior, warm golden lighting and a relaxed café atmosphere in Vijay Nagar. It’s a spot to meet friends, share a meal and make an ordinary outing feel special.

Come as you are. Meet a friend, find a quiet corner, or simply enjoy a moment that belongs only to you.
